hypothesis: A BM25/character-trigram rank-fusion candidate improves macro top1 by at least 0.05 under a fixed single adjacent-letter transposition while preserving clean DEV macro top1 and cold runtime no more than 2x BM25.
scope: DEVELOPMENT_ONLY; synthetic typo robustness; NOT independent-source generalization
baseline: BM25 k1=1.2 b=0.75 on lowercase ASCII alphanumeric tokens; full provided candidate set
perturbation: Choose earliest longest ASCII alphabetic word of length>=6 in query, swap its middle adjacent distinct letters; search other adjacent positions then next length-sorted word if needed. Exactly one transposition; no doc/gold access. Preserve unperturbable query.
selection: TRAIN only: discard candidates below BM25 clean macro accuracy; maximize corrupted macro accuracy, then clean macro accuracy, then smallest alpha. If all fail, record NO_TRAIN_ADMISSION and no DEV scoring.
dev: Freeze selected alpha receipt before one DEV comparison against BM25. Report clean and corrupted macro accuracy and counts separately.
cost: Independent cold paths include document preprocessing and both clean/corrupted queries. Three repetitions with order BM25/candidate, candidate/BM25, BM25/candidate; median wall time. Not general hardware benchmark.
stopping: One frozen candidate evaluation; no hyperparameter expansion or retry based on outcome. Runtime errors can be repaired only with new version and preserved failure.
limitations: DEV historically exposed and BM25 already saturated.
Artificial typographical perturbations do not establish real-user utility.
No changed data membership, new sources, label edits, or sealed TEST release.
artifact_role: TEMPLATE, NOT the exact frozen execution manifest
